mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.category_id, a.summary, a.content_path, a.layout, a.ext, a.status, a.view_count, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.name AS category_name
FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id
mapper.select: SELECT t.name FROM tag t INNER JOIN article_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id WHERE at.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, category_id, summary, content_path, layout, ext, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{categoryId}, #{summary}, #{contentPath}, #{layout}, #{ext, typeHandler=com.blog.common.JacksonMapTypeHandler}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET title = #{title}, category_id = #{categoryId}, summary = #{summary}, content_path = #{contentPath}, layout = #{layout}, ext = #{ext, typeHandler=com.blog.common.JacksonMapTypeHandler}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
